sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Why today of all days? My alarm worked! I know it did!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and incredulous, half-panicking at the unfairness of being late on the very first day while trying to convince herself it wasn’t her fault.
sprite_sequence.label: unconvinced

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s suddenly panicked and flustered, with a sharp spike of worry as she realizes her morning is getting even worse and she may be in trouble.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on, don't do this to me!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is panicked and flustered, desperately trying to stay upbeat while feeling the first-day disaster closing in on her.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Seriously... I stopped to read that creepy note, and now my pass is gone?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and irritated, with a rising sense of self-blame and disbelief as she realizes her own curiosity may have caused the disaster.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: I'm late, I'm cardless, and I'm trying very hard not to become a tragedy in a school uniform.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and embarrassed but still trying to stay upbeat, using humor to mask rising panic and keep herself from spiraling.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp mix of disbelief and wary relief, with her panic briefly giving way to suspicious hope that the strange note might actually be leading somewhere.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is breathless and panicked but also energized by the urgency, trying to stay upbeat and socially smooth while racing to fix the disaster before it ruins her first day.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sudden, overwhelming relief and grateful excitement, with a burst of breathless urgency as she recognizes her pass and rushes to reclaim control of the morning.
sprite_sequence.label: astonished

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and suddenly wary, with her earlier panic shifting into tense suspicion as she tries to understand how a stranger knows so much about her.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, wow. That's not a normal sentence.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s startled and uneasy, but trying to mask it with dry humor while her curiosity and alarm spike at the stranger’s eerie, intimate knowledge of her.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Did my friends put you up to this? Because this prank is way too elaborate for eight in the morning.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels startled but trying to regain control with joking suspicion, masking rising unease and curiosity behind her usual bold, talkative energy.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: That made it worse. You know that, right?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels rattled and suspicious, with a sharp edge of exasperation under her fear as the stranger’s cryptic warning makes the situation feel even more unsettling.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is jolted into alarmed disbelief, trying to reject the eerie situation outright while masking her fear with blunt, defensive certainty.
sprite_sequence.label: unconvinced

sprite_sequence.text: People do not just vanish before homeroom!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is jolted from disbelief into alarmed, indignant panic, trying to force the situation back into something normal by speaking with loud, frustrated certainty.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Aah— school! Mystery later, attendance first!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is forcing herself into brisk, upbeat determination, using humor and urgency to push past her fear and focus on getting to school on time.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Seat by the window, huh... If that's true, who were you?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s rattled but intensely curious, trying to turn her fear into a determined need to figure out who the stranger was and why they knew so much about her.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused
